title: AssetManifest
description: Declares the 3D assets a Season needs. Authors declare desired assets; the continuous background generation pipeline converges the world toward this desired state. See docs/05_Technical_Architecture.md (Continuous background asset generation) and docs/07_AI_Agent_Implementation_Guide.md T-CONTENT-004.

season_id.description: Season this manifest belongs to, e.g. 'season-001'.

assets.description: The desired 3D assets for this Season.

id.description: Stable, human-readable asset id (kebab-case). Unique within the manifest.

name.description: Short display name for the asset.

description.description: Optional human notes. Not part of the content-address.

kind.description: What the asset is, in world terms.

vignette_ids.description: Vignettes that use this asset (optional). Not part of the content-address.

license.description: License of the generated asset (e.g. CC0, proprietary, provider-terms).

budget_tier.description: Cost routing hint. Not part of the content-address.

content_address.description: sha256 of the canonical generation inputs (kind + generation). Stable identity used for dedup, caching, and reproducibility. Computed/verified by tools/content-validator.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Authors leave this 'desired'; the pipeline flips it to 'ready'.

generation.description: The generation inputs. These fields, together with the asset kind, are exactly what the content-address hashes.

provider.description: Generation provider. 'self-hosted' is the open-model fallback.

references.description: Reference images for image-to-3d. Required when mode is image-to-3d (enforced by the validator).

params.description: Provider-tunable generation parameters. Hashed via canonical (sorted-key) JSON.

pipeline_version.description: Version of the post-processing pipeline. Bumping it invalidates content-addresses and triggers regeneration.

sha256.description: Optional integrity hash of the reference image.
